video_title: Never Have I Been So Much Tired ⚡ Sergey Esenin @TheLegendaryPoet
comment_text:
📖 Sergey Esenin wrote «Я усталым таким ещё не был…» in 1923. It was first published in 1924 in the journal «Гостиница для путешествующих в прекрасном», together with other poems connected with «Москва кабацкая».

This English adaptation keeps the contrast between the remembered Ryazan sky and the exhausted urban voice. Which image remained strongest for you after listening?
